h1: The 7 Best Lightweight Bagged Vacuums for Allergies, Pets and Stairs in 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Lightweight Bagged Vacuums: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 lightweight bagged vacuums from Kenmore, Oreck and Bissell, upright and canister, compared on HEPA, tools and price.
summary: The Kenmore 81214 200 Series is the lightweight bagged vacuum to buy, pairing a two-motor canister with confirmed HEPA filtration and three tools at a mid-range price. The Kenmore 81414 adds a retractable cord and a fourth tool, the Oreck HEPA upright is the lightest certified upright, and the Bissell Zing is the budget pick.
intro: Light weight in a vacuum can mean two very different things, and buyers rarely separate them. One is a light body, easy to carry up stairs. The other is a low-effort push, which depends on how the brush engages the carpet. A light upright that grabs the rug will still feel heavy to push. Check what you care about before you chase a number on a box.

This ranking sorts seven lightweight bagged machines, both uprights and canisters, by filtration, tool kit, cord handling and how they suit stairs, pets and hard floors. We reviewed listings and specs, not owner use, and the listings give weights for few models, so we compare relative portability, not pounds.

products.name: Kenmore 81214 200 Series Pet Friendly Lightweight Bagged Canister Vacuum with HEPA
products.verdict: A lightweight canister with confirmed HEPA, a two-motor system and three tools.
products.description:
The Kenmore 81214 is a lightweight bagged canister with a two-motor system, confirmed HEPA filtration and three cleaning tools. It is priced at $100 to $200, and is aimed at pet households.

It wins because it combines the three things that decide a bagged vacuum: a sealed bag system, a HEPA filter that makes the exhaust cleaner, and separate motors, which split suction and brushing. Canister designs also hold the heavy motor on the floor, so you only lift the wand and hose, which is why they feel light on stairs.

Buy it if you have pets or allergies and want a light, filtered machine. Skip it if you prefer an upright.
pros: Canister design is easy on stairs
cons: Canisters trail the body behind you
products.idealFor: Pet owners and allergy sufferers wanting light handling.

products.name: Kenmore 81414 400 Series Pet Friendly Lightweight Bagged Canister Vacuum with Extended Telescoping Wand
products.verdict: A fuller kit with four tools, a retractable cord and an extended telescoping wand.
products.description:
The Kenmore 81414 is a bagged canister with an extended telescoping wand, four cleaning tools and a retractable cord. It sits in the $200 to $500 tier and suits buyers after a complete set of attachments that still stays light.

The retractable cord and the extended wand are the daily-use upgrades: no manual winding, and a reach that suits taller users or high shelves. It ranks just below the 81214 because the added price is mostly convenience, not performance, and the listing does not mention HEPA the way the cheaper model's does.

Buy it if you value the extra tool and cord convenience. Skip it if you want confirmed HEPA at a lower price.
products.idealFor: Users who want the fullest tool kit.
products.skipIf: You want confirmed HEPA at a lower price.

products.name: Oreck HEPA Upright Vacuum Cleaner, Lightweight Bagged Upright Vac
products.verdict: Oreck's HEPA-certified flagship upright, built for light weight.
products.description:
The Oreck HEPA upright is a lightweight bagged upright with HEPA certification. It costs $200 to $500 and is positioned for buyers who want light weight plus certified filtration.

Uprights are better at carpet and wide floors, and Oreck has built its name on light uprights for decades. The HEPA certification is the headline, and bag containment keeps dust sealed during disposal. It ranks third because canisters win on stairs and furniture, and because certification adds cost.

Buy it if you want a light upright with certified HEPA. Skip it if you mostly clean stairs and upholstery.
products.skipIf: Stairs and furniture are your main job.

products.name: Oreck Commercial XL Vacuum Cleaner, Bagged Upright Vac, Lightweight
products.verdict: The lightest commercial-grade upright here, with a bag system and a lower price.
products.description:
The Oreck Commercial XL is a lightweight bagged upright built for commercial use. It costs $100 to $200 and is the pick for buyers who want a commercial machine that is easy to carry.

Commercial uprights are designed for repeated daily use, so they tend to be simpler and sturdier than household uprights. It ranks fourth because it is the plainer machine next to the Oreck HEPA, with no stated HEPA certification, and the listing offers few specifics beyond weight and bag.

Buy it if you want a light, simple upright for carpet. Skip it if filtration is your priority.
products.idealFor: Daily carpet cleaning with a simple machine.

products.name: Kenmore Pet Friendly Lightweight Bagged Canister Vacuum Cleaner
products.verdict: A light pet-friendly canister that suits furniture-heavy homes with sealed disposal.
products.description:
This Kenmore is a lightweight pet-friendly bagged canister, positioned for furniture-heavy homes. It costs $200 to $500.

Canisters sit well under chairs and tables, and a flexible hose reaches around obstacles without dragging the body. Sealed bag disposal suits pet owners who want low exposure to dust. It ranks fifth because the listing is thin on specs compared with the numbered Kenmore models and the price tier is the same as the 81414.

Buy it if you have lots of furniture and pets. Skip it if you want a documented feature list.
products.idealFor: Homes with lots of furniture and pets.

products.name: Bissell Zing Lightweight Bagged Canister Vacuum, Purple, 2154A
products.verdict: A budget-minded bagged canister that keeps weight down.
products.description:
The Bissell Zing is a lightweight bagged canister, model 2154A, in the $50 to $100 tier. It is for budget-conscious buyers who still want a light machine.

At its price, it covers the essentials: a bag system, a canister body and a hose and wand. It ranks sixth because the listing gives no HEPA claim, motor figure or tool count. A budget canister like this suits dorm rooms, apartments and secondary floors.

Buy it if you want the cheapest light bagged option. Skip it if you need HEPA or a full tool set.

products.name: Kenmore Intuition Bagged Upright Vacuum Cleaner Lightweight
products.verdict: The lowest-cost lightweight upright in the group.
products.description:
The Kenmore Intuition is a lightweight bagged upright in the $100 to $200 tier, and the lowest-cost lightweight option in this group.

It is the basic choice: an upright with a bag, suited to carpet and open floors. It ranks last because the listing gives no HEPA claim or feature list, and because the canisters above outperform it on stairs and upholstery.

Buy it if you want a simple, light upright for the lowest price in the tier. Skip it if you want more features.
products.skipIf: You want filtration or tool variety.

whatMatters.detail: Uprights push easily across carpet and cover wide areas, while canisters leave the heavy motor on the floor and suit stairs, furniture and hard floors. A canister feels lighter in the hand even at the same weight. Pick by the surface you vacuum most.
A sealed bag traps dust when you remove it, which matters for allergies. HEPA-rated bags and filters capture very fine particles. Check the listing for HEPA, and for how the bag is sealed.
Crevice, upholstery and dusting tools make a light canister more useful on furniture and stairs. Extra tools matter more than extra suction. Count what ships in the box.
A retractable cord saves winding time and tangles. Long cords reduce outlet swapping. Check whether the cord rewinds automatically.
Bagged vacuums need replacement bags, so check the bag type and price before buying. Common bag types are easy to find. Rare ones can be an ongoing hassle.

faq.q: Are bagged vacuums better for allergies?
faq.a: They can be, because a sealed bag contains dust when you dispose of it. Look for HEPA filtration as well.
Choosing by weight alone. A light upright can still feel heavy to push, so consider the floor type and design.

faq.q: Is the Kenmore 81414 worth it over the 81214?
faq.a: If you value the retractable cord, extra tool and longer wand, yes. If you want HEPA at a lower price, the 81214 is better.
Easy. Insert a bag, attach the hose and wand, plug in. Most take minutes.

faq.q: How often do I change the bag?
faq.a: When it is about two-thirds full, or when suction drops. A full bag reduces airflow.

faq.q: Can a canister clean carpet well?
faq.a: Yes with the right floor head. Check that the head is suited to carpet and not only hard floors.

finalTake: For most homes, the Kenmore 81214 200 Series is the best lightweight bagged vacuum: a two-motor canister with confirmed HEPA, three tools and a mid-range price. The Kenmore 81414 is the better kit for stairs, the Oreck HEPA upright suits carpet, and the Bissell Zing is the cheapest. Choose upright or canister by floor type first.
